description: `obj.__dict__`, the per-object dictionary that assignment writes to by default.
A name stored in the class `__dict__`, shared by every instance until an instance shadows it.
An object on a class that defines `__get__`, `__set__` or `__delete__` and so takes over attribute access. `property`, functions and `classmethod` are descriptors.
A descriptor with `__set__` or `__delete__`. It wins over the instance `__dict__`; a non-data descriptor loses to it.
Method Resolution Order: the list of classes (`Cls.__mro__`) searched for an attribute, computed with C3 linearization.
